summary: Frontend-only testing of iteration-20 navigation refactor (BottomDock + POS reflow + Payment Link QR). Most of the new UX scaffolding is wired correctly: sidebar is removed, BottomDock is global with role-based quick actions + More splash, all 4 roles default-land on /pos, POS now groups products by category in the All view with a wider 440px cart panel, and Payment Links has a working QR modal with download/copy. HOWEVER, the headline feature of this iteration — left-swipe-delete / right-swipe-repeat on cart items — is COMPLETELY non-functional: the SwipeableCartItem component is defined but never used in the cart render. In addition, several role quick-action dock buttons are hidden because the customPermissions filter in BottomDock excludes paths that the seeded staff users don't have explicit permission strings for.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL — SwipeableCartItem (lines 21-108) is defined but NEVER used. The cart panel at line 469-483 still renders a plain <Card> with old quantity buttons (no data-testid on +/-, no Trash icon swipe, no hint text). Therefore cart-item-wrapper-{id}, cart-plus-{id}, cart-minus-{id}, swipe-delete-bg-{id}, swipe-repeat-bg-{id}, and the '← swipe delete · repeat swipe →' hint are ALL absent. Left-swipe-delete and right-swipe-repeat features do not work AT ALL.

HIGH — Manager dock missing dock-reservations and dock-staff-roster; Cashier dock missing dock-loyalty; Kitchen dock missing dock-inventory and dock-ai-pantry. Root cause: when user.customPermissions is set, the .filter() at line 127-131 evaluates `customPerms.includes(q.path.replace('/', ''))` and the seeded staff users don't have those exact path-keys in their permissions array. So the role's Quick Action set is silently truncated to whichever paths happen to be in customPerms. Owner is unaffected (early return).
Console warning on every page load — 'An empty string was passed to the src attribute'. A product (likely Smoothies — seen rendering as text alt in screenshot) has an empty image URL.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be tested at all — the swipe component is not mounted. Even the manual unit-level swipe logic in SwipeableCartItem looks correct, but it is unreachable from the running UI.

action_items: URGENT: In /app/frontend/src/pages/POSTerminal.jsx around line 469-483, replace the inline <Card data-testid='cart-item-${item.id}'>...</Card> render with <SwipeableCartItem item={item} onUpdateQty={updateQuantity} onRemove={removeFromCart} onRepeat={(it)=>updateQuantity(it.id, it.quantity+1)} theme={theme} />. Without this fix the entire iteration-20 swipe feature is dead.

Fix BottomDock role-action filter (lines 127-131): for QUICK_ACTIONS the role is the source of truth — drop the customPerms filter for quick actions, OR ensure seeded manager/cashier/kitchen users have the path-keys (reservations, staff-roster, loyalty, inventory, ai-pantry, etc.) in their customPermissions list. Same fix is needed for `isAllowed` so splash tiles also show Bookings/Loyalty/etc. for staff users.
Fix product image with empty src (likely Smoothies — set placeholder or skip if !item.image).
critical_code_review_comments: POSTerminal.jsx is now 752 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Worth splitting cart panel + payment modals into sub-components.
Dead-code component SwipeableCartItem ships in the bundle but provides no value because it's never rendered. Either wire it up (preferred) or remove.

BottomDock customPermissions filter conflates 'role-based default' with 'fine-grained access control'. Quick actions should be derived from role; only the More splash should respect granular permissions.

seed_data_creation: Created 1 payment link via UI (Generate Link button) to validate QR modal — link persisted, QR opened with SVG, Download QR + Copy Link buttons present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working: (1) all roles land on /pos after login; (2) Sidebar fully removed from layout — no [data-testid='sidebar'] anywhere; (3) BottomDock testid='bottom-dock' visible on every authenticated page; (4) More splash testid='more-splash' opens, X close + backdrop click both dismiss, tile click navigates; (5) Owner sees 38 splash tiles, Cashier hides Accounting+Dashboard tiles, Manager hides Accounting+BAS-GST — RBAC works for splash; (6) POS All view shows 3 grouped sections (BEVERAGES, BAKERY, FOOD) with data-testid='pos-category-section-{cat}'; (7) Cart panel w-[440px] confirmed; (8) Payment Links page QR button (data-testid='qr-{id}') opens qr-modal with QRCodeSVG + download-qr-btn + copy-qr-btn; (9) dock-logout works → returns to login. After main agent fixes the SwipeableCartItem usage, retest swipe-left (delete) and swipe-right (repeat) gestures using mouse.move + mouse.down + step-by-step mouse.move loop (12 steps × 12px = 144px > 80px threshold) on cart-item-wrapper-{id} starting from x = box.x+100 to avoid the data-no-swipe quantity button area on the right.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Swipe feature dead — the developer extracted SwipeableCartItem at the top of POSTerminal.jsx but forgot to replace the inline cart Card with it; the file still has the old plain <Card data-testid={`cart-item-${item.id}`}> at line 470 inside the cart.map(). One-line fix. 2) Role dock truncated — BottomDock.jsx line 127-131 filters QUICK_ACTIONS by customPermissions when hasCustomPerms is true, but seed staff users have a partial customPermissions array that omits some role-default paths, causing silent removal. Fix is either to drop the filter for quick actions (role is enough) or to expand seeded customPermissions to include the per-role default paths.
